content.title: Zillow, Other Online Home Listings Stocks Drop as Google Tests Ads
content.summary: The turf war over real estate listings could get a big new entrant.  Stocks for companies with home for-sale listing websites fell sharply on Monday on news that  Alphabet  Google is testing its own ads at the top of search results.  Google is incorporating the ads into Google Search in some parts of the country, a Google spokesperson said.

content.title: Why Zillow (ZG) Stock Is Down Today
content.summary: Shares of online real estate marketplace Zillow (NASDAQ:ZG) fell 8.1% in the afternoon session after reports surfaced that Google was testing a new feature to display home sale listings directly within its search results.
